🕴️ Pose: Mirror Selfie
Standing before a reflective surface with device raised — the classic mirror selfie composition.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Mirror Selfie.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, turn the body slightly and orient the face toward an implied mirror plane. Show a phone, camera, or visible mirror only when supported by another selected visual trait or the selected scene; otherwise use the same turned pose without adding props or changing the crop. Female: the turn breaks at the waist and the hip cants. Male: the turn holds square from shoulder to hip. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own turned line.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
